info.title: SyntaxLab Parser API
info.description: Syntactic analysis from identified parsers, normalized to a language-independent schema. Languages and engines are configured, not hard-coded: see `GET /api/v1/languages` for what this deployment supports.

Capability.title: Capability
Capability.description: What an engine can produce for a language.

step.title: Step
step.description: Trace step at which the item was added.

component.title: Component
component.description: Engine component that produced this layer.

constituents.title: Constituents
constituents.description: In creation order; for identical spans, earlier entries dominate later ones.

parse_count.title: Parse Count
parse_count.description: Number of parses the grammar allows for the sentence.

matched_parse.title: Matched Parse
matched_parse.description: 1-based index of the parse matched exactly.

reference.description: The matched or closest parse, with empty constituents removed.

children.title: Children
children.description: Child node ids, in surface order.

token_id.title: Token Id
token_id.description: Set on pre-terminal nodes: the word this node dominates. Such nodes have no children.

relation_status.title: Relation Status
relation_status.description: partial = right base relation, but the annotation uses a subtype (or vice versa).

textbook.title: Textbook
textbook.description: Closest category in introductory textbooks (reading aid only).

gloss_standard.title: Gloss Standard
gloss_standard.description: False if the abbreviation is not in the Leipzig Glossing Rules list.

index.title: Index
index.description: 0 is the augmented rule γ → start added by the parser.

name.title: Name
name.description: Plain-language name from the curated glossary, if any.

structures.title: Structures
structures.description: Structural analyses that can be requested for this language.

structures.title: Structures
structures.description: Structural analyses that can be requested for this language.

first.title: First
first.description: First word id covered by this orthographic token.

Notice.title: Notice
Notice.description: A warning or limitation the user should see alongside an analysis.

unknown_tokens.title: Unknown Tokens
unknown_tokens.description: Positions of words that no rule produces.

tree_count.title: Tree Count
tree_count.description: Exact number of parse trees, capped at tree_count_cap.

text.title: Text
examples: I saw the man with a telescope.

structures.title: Structures
structures.description: Structural analyses to produce. Omit to get every structure the language supports. Requesting an unsupported structure is an error, never a fallback.

text.title: Text
text.description: The analyzed text after Unicode NFC normalization.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: One tag per word (null = not answered).

PosFamily.title: PosFamily
PosFamily.description: Coarse grouping of POS tags, used for consistent colouring across schemes.

StructureKind.title: StructureKind
StructureKind.description: Structural analyses a client can request. Token-level annotations come with every parse.

constituent.title: Constituent
constituent.description: Index in the submitted list, if specific.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: For no_rule: the rule the tree would need.

id.title: Id
id.description: 1-based syntactic word index within the sentence.

added.title: Added
added.description: False if the item was already in the chart.
